note: Implemented a two-lane arm64 NEON F64 exp leaf with interleaved degree-13 FMA chains and composed ExpSumF64, ExpScaledF64, SigmoidF64, and SoftplusNegLLSumF64. Unsafe, nonfinite, and subnormal-boundary inputs preserve scalar semantics; ExpSum remains in-place safe, distinct inputs remain immutable, odd tails are scalar, and backend/cpu.vexpF64Fast stays false. The original non-target scalar file body is preserved to avoid compiler-layout bit drift; GOARCH x goexperiment.simd goldens explicitly cover the intentional GBM sigmoid change. Exact benchmark control b772a8389056afba436e9d33a0eeb3a0523fc340 versus product candidate a142a29ae1caa7f7c0fac8a042ce4c9de79f3dc6: three alternating paired count-seven Apple M2 Pro campaigns, every cell p=0.001 and zero allocations; time reductions span 37.12%-63.50%, with geomean reductions 51.50%, 52.37%, and 52.61%. Benchmark records M-01M0HSYRS2F0N, M-01M0HSZ6VWE5D, M-01M0HSZB8TFXT. Objdump confirms D2 VFMLA/VFMLS, FRINTN, and exponent-bit construction. Full pure-Go and cgo/Metal tests, arm64 SIMD build/vet/classic integration/race, benchmark smoke, actionlint, tidy, and linux-arm64/linux-amd64/windows-amd64 SIMD cross-builds passed. Full SIMD and race baseline failures in unrelated nlp/nn/autograd/classic tests were reproduced on exact origin/main. Generalized detection findings are perfscan issues #794 and #795.

Archived after PR #1127 head e0b7095dfa176a3fefa8b14a5eca0a8261a7d498 completed the full 15-check CI matrix successfully (run 32468409469). The final implementation adds an Apple arm64 goexperiment.simd two-lane F64 NEON exponential leaf and composes ExpSumF64, ExpScaledF64, SigmoidF64, and SoftplusNegLLSumF64 with scalar fallback for unsafe, non-finite, and subnormal-boundary domains; odd tails, in-place aliasing, distinct-input immutability, and zero-allocation contracts are covered. Physical Apple M2 Pro alternating paired count=7 campaigns against exact harness control b772a8389056afba436e9d33a0eeb3a0523fc340 and product a142a29ae1caa7f7c0fac8a042ce4c9de79f3dc6 produced geomean latency reductions of 51.50%, 52.37%, and 52.61%; direct 32K leaf latency improved 62.69%-63.50%, all cells p=0.001 and 0 B/op, 0 allocs/op. Objdump verified D2 VFMLA/VFMLS, FRINTN, and exponent-bit construction. A CI-discovered test-scoping correction in e0b7095d moved arm64-specific fallback contracts behind arm64+SIMD tags because the pre-existing amd64 AVX path intentionally clamps -709; arm64 SIMD, amd64 SIMD, portable defaults, and the complete CI matrix then passed. Pre-existing unrelated full-race autograd/classic and full-SIMD nlp/nn failures were reproduced on origin/main and excluded from this change. backend/cpu vexpF64Fast remains false; WKV/SSM promotion remains deferred. Generalizable findings are tracked in perfscan #794 and #795. No independent second-identity validation was performed because subagents are forbidden absent an explicit user request; the implementation instead received Spectackle grill/review plus local and CI evidence.
